measurement.hardware: AMD Radeon Graphics (RADV NAVI31) 48 GiB; dual EPYC 9334; 16-core cgroup quota
measurement.build: Rust 1.98.1 full release, fat LTO, codegen-units=1, target-cpu=native, features=vulkan; no parity-trace
measurement.known_workload_monitor: Per-job 3-second idle start; sample rustc, ld/ld.lld/lld, cc1/cc1plus, clang/clang++, gcc/g++, lto1 and other named rust-model-inference/gpu-probe/timestral_bench clients. Rows retained in observed_compilers; reject any nonempty measurement. Does not prove exclusive physical-host/GPU ownership. Transfers may coexist.
measurement.baseline_protocol: Baseline CPU+Vulkan, matched inputs/model/build flags on same remote device. Optimized release measures Vulkan only; final forecasts compare with accepted baseline CPU and GPU outputs. CPU inference code unchanged.
limits: Synthetic single-request inputs, no service concurrency or official dataset quality evaluation.
Maximum context has one warm and one CLI sample per backend.
NAVI31 final outputs checked, intermediate Oracle checkpoints checked on M3 Max.
Short-input complete CLI retains a startup regression; short resident GPU remains slower than CPU.
measurement.additional_cli_sampling: Five alternating baseline/optimized CLI samples per binary for short and standard, added to initial two; all seven retained, including spikes. Only these cases use seven CLI samples. Others retain two, max_context one.

synchronized_diagnostic.method: Temporary flush and wait after each operation; wall-clock including CPU recording and extra submission overhead, not GPU timestamps. Not used for end-to-end speedups.
